summary: This clinical trial studies how exercise and insulin delivered through a nose spray affect brain blood flow and thinking skills in adults with type 2 diabetes. The study plans to enroll 60 participants between the ages of 55 and 80. Rutgers, The State University of New Jersey is sponsoring this Phase 2/3 trial, which is currently Recruiting. Participants will test combinations of high-intensity exercise and either an intranasal insulin drug or an inactive placebo drug.
